mode_note: dry_run logs what WOULD be routed and touches no agent. live refers messages to the owning domain (record only - nothing executes from an email) and tells the principal. Switched by the principal, never by code.
routable_note: Legal: court filings, service notices. Accounting: payment confirmations, receipts. Grow: the plants. Anything else, or anything two of these claim, is HELD for the principal.
